title: ze_screaming_bells BETA
description:
The Screaming Bells 

 In the End Times, Chaos rises and the Skaven are taking over the world. Our only hope is to destroy their Screaming Bells. 

 
This map is intended to be played on a zombie escape server running [url= 
CS2Fixes
 

Source code and vmaps are public in my [url= 
GitHub Repository
 

Admin room in the second tower at spawn
 setpos -11144 -595 -2016 

 

 Current State 

1 playable stage with 3 additional stages planned

 Note: Some screenshots show unfinished or unplayable stages. 

More NPCs, bosses, and items are planned.

 Map Features 

 
 1 playable stage
 1 NPC type
 1 boss
 Nav-meshed pathfinding for NPCs and bosses
 3 Human spell books
 Spell books can be corrupted by zombies which converts them to zombie items
 3 Zombie-only items found at the start of each level
 

 Human Spell Items 

 Thunder — Blue Book 
 Human: Boosts the user back and instantly stuns zombies for 2 seconds and deals 500 damage.
 Corrupted: Boosts the user back and instantly stuns humans for 2 seconds and deals 30 damage.

 Fireball — Orange Book 
 Human: Fires a projectile that slows zombies for 5 seconds and deals 1000 damage. Deals 300 damage to NPCs and bosses.
 Corrupted: Fires a projectile that slows humans for 5 seconds and deals 20 damage. Deals 300 damage to NPCs and bosses.

 Heal — Green Book 
 Human: Heals humans for 10 HP/s for 15 seconds.
 Corrupted: Heals zombies for 500 HP/s for 15 seconds.

 Zombie-Only Items 

 ZM Tornado 
Fires a projectile. After 3 seconds, it creates a tornado that lasts 8 seconds.

 ZM Leech 
Fires a projectile that latches onto a human, pulls nearby humans in, and deals 10 HP/s.
The leech can be killed and has 20 HP per leeched human.

 ZM Rage 
Channels for 5 seconds, then emits a zombie speed aura that also damages humans for 15 HP/s.
While channeling, the zombie cannot move and humans can shoot to break the channel.
